```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(vegan)
```

```{r}
chem <- read_csv(here("outputs", "chem_clusters_2025-12-03.csv"))

env <- read_csv(here("outputs", "enviro_2025-12-03.csv"))

vert <- read_csv(here("outputs", "vertical_metrics.csv"))
```

```{r}
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. DATA PREPARATION
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Remove ...1 columns
chem_clean <- chem %>% select(-`...1`)
env_clean <- env %>% select(-`...1`)

# Average environmental data by date and station
env_averaged <- env_clean %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(
    across(where(is.numeric), ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

env_averaged <- env_averaged %>% 
  left_join(vert)

# Check for any columns that became all NA
na_cols <- env_averaged %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~sum(is.na(.)))) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything()) %>%
  filter(value == nrow(env_averaged))

if(nrow(na_cols) > 0) {
  cat("Warning: These columns are all NA after averaging:\n")
  print(na_cols$name)
}

# Join CHEMTAX with environmental data
rda_data <- chem_clean %>%
  left_join(env_averaged, by = c("date")) %>%
  drop_na()  # Remove any rows with missing data

cat("\n=== DATA COVERAGE ===\n")
cat("CHEMTAX samples:", nrow(chem_clean), "\n")
cat("After joining with env data:", nrow(rda_data), "\n")
cat("Coverage:", round(nrow(rda_data) / nrow(chem_clean) * 100, 1), "%\n")
```


```{r}
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. PREPARE RDA MATRICES
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Response matrix: Phytoplankton groups (relative abundance)
# Assuming your 8 phyto groups are named: diat, raph, dict, dino, cryp, GA, hapt, cyan
phyto_groups <- c("diat", "raph", "dict", "dino", "cryp", "GA", "hapt", "cyan")

phyto_response <- rda_data %>%
  select(all_of(phyto_groups)) %>%
  as.data.frame()

# Predictor matrix: Environmental variables
# Remove non-numeric and identifier columns
env_predictors <- rda_data %>%
  select(-all_of(phyto_groups), -date, -abs_clust) %>%
  select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
  as.data.frame()

env_predictors <- env_predictors %>%
  select(-sigma_5m,
         -sigma_30m,
         -density_5m,
         -density_30m,
         -delta_sigma_5_30,
         -temp_30m,
         -sal_30m,
         -nitrate_30m,
         -phosphate_5m,
         -phosphate_30m,
         -silicate_5m,
         -silicate_30m,
         -delta_phosphate_5_30,
         -delta_silicate_5_30,
         -sigma_30m,
         -mean_N2,
         -stratification_index,
         -qgm_10,
         -Q_SM,
         -Q_GM,
         -w_dm,
         -wd_dm,
         -nutrient_isolation,
         -pycnocline_depth,
         -n_casts,
         -nitrate_depletion,
         -surface_depletion,
         -NP_ratio_5m,
         -delta_nitrate_5_30,
         -profile_shape,
         -centroid_depth)

# env_predictors <- env_predictors %>%
#   select(temp_5m,
#          sal_5m,
#          nitrate_5m,
#          nitrate_30m,
#          delta_sigma_2_30,
#          delta_temp_5_30,
#          wind_b1_3,
#          wd_b1_3,
#          qsm_10,
#          NP_ratio_5m,
#         )

# Check for columns with zero variance (will cause problems)
zero_var_cols <- env_predictors %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~var(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything()) %>%
  filter(value == 0 | is.na(value))

if(nrow(zero_var_cols) > 0) {
  cat("\nRemoving zero-variance columns:\n")
  print(zero_var_cols$name)
  env_predictors <- env_predictors %>%
    select(-all_of(zero_var_cols$name))
}

# Standardize environmental variables (important for RDA!)
env_scaled <- scale(env_predictors)
```


```{r}
# Check for perfect collinearity
cor_matrix <- cor(env_scaled, use = "complete.obs")
high_cor <- which(abs(cor_matrix) > 0.9 & cor_matrix != 1, arr.ind = TRUE)

if(nrow(high_cor) > 0) {
  cat("\nWarning: High correlations detected between:\n")
  for(i in 1:nrow(high_cor)) {
    cat(rownames(cor_matrix)[high_cor[i,1]], "and", 
        colnames(cor_matrix)[high_cor[i,2]], 
        "r =", round(cor_matrix[high_cor[i,1], high_cor[i,2]], 3), "\n")
  }
  cat("Consider removing one variable from each pair.\n")
}

cat("\n=== RDA DATA SUMMARY ===\n")
cat("Response variables (phyto groups):", ncol(phyto_response), "\n")
cat("Predictor variables (env):", ncol(env_scaled), "\n")
cat("Number of samples:", nrow(rda_data), "\n")
```


```{r}
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. RUN RDA
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Full model with all environmental variables
rda_full <- rda(phyto_response ~ ., data = as.data.frame(env_scaled))

# Model summary
cat("\n=== RDA MODEL SUMMARY ===\n")
summary(rda_full)

# Variance partitioning
cat("\n=== VARIANCE EXPLAINED ===\n")
r2 <- RsquareAdj(rda_full)
cat("R² =", round(r2$r.squared, 3), "\n")
cat("Adjusted R² =", round(r2$adj.r.squared, 3), "\n")

# Overall significance test
cat("\n=== OVERALL MODEL SIGNIFICANCE ===\n")
anova_full <- anova(rda_full, permutations = 999)
print(anova_full)

# Test significance of each environmental variable
cat("\n=== INDIVIDUAL VARIABLE SIGNIFICANCE ===\n")
anova_terms <- anova(rda_full, by = "terms", permutations = 999)
print(anova_terms)

# Test significance of each RDA axis
cat("\n=== RDA AXIS SIGNIFICANCE ===\n")
anova_axis <- anova(rda_full, by = "axis", permutations = 999)
print(anova_axis)
```

```{r}
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Calculate VIF for the FULL model
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("\n=== VARIANCE INFLATION FACTORS (VIF) - FULL MODEL ===\n")

# VIF from RDA model
vif_full <- vif.cca(rda_full)

vif_df_full <- data.frame(
  Variable = names(vif_full),
  VIF = vif_full
) %>%
  arrange(desc(VIF)) %>%
  mutate(
    Problem = case_when(
      VIF > 10 ~ "SEVERE multicollinearity",
      VIF > 5 ~ "Moderate multicollinearity",
      VIF > 3 ~ "Mild multicollinearity",
      TRUE ~ "OK"
    )
  )

print(vif_df_full)

# Plot VIF values
p_vif_full <- ggplot(vif_df_full, aes(x = reorder(Variable, VIF), y = VIF)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = VIF > 10), show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 10, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 5, linetype = "dashed", color = "orange", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(VIF, 1)), hjust = -0.2, size = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#E74C3C", "FALSE" = "#3498DB")) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Variance Inflation Factors - Full Model",
    subtitle = "VIF > 10 = severe collinearity | VIF > 5 = moderate",
    x = "Variable",
    y = "VIF"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5)
  )

print(p_vif_full)

ggsave(here("figures", "vif_full_model.png"),
       width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```



```{r}
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. FORWARD SELECTION (if you have many predictors)
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Start with null model
rda_null <- rda(phyto_response ~ 1, data = as.data.frame(env_scaled))

# Forward selection to identify key drivers
cat("\n=== FORWARD SELECTION ===\n")
rda_forward <- ordiR2step(
  rda_null,
  scope = formula(rda_full),
  direction = "forward",
  permutations = 999,
  trace = FALSE
)

print(rda_forward$anova)

# Use reduced model with only significant predictors
rda_reduced <- rda_forward

cat("\n=== REDUCED MODEL VARIANCE ===\n")
r2_reduced <- RsquareAdj(rda_reduced)
cat("R² =", round(r2_reduced$r.squared, 3), "\n")
cat("Adjusted R² =", round(r2_reduced$adj.r.squared, 3), "\n")

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. VISUALIZATION
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Extract scores
site_scores <- scores(rda_reduced, display = "sites", choices = 1:2)
species_scores <- scores(rda_reduced, display = "species", choices = 1:2)
env_scores <- scores(rda_reduced, display = "bp", choices = 1:2)

# Prepare plotting data
plot_data <- as.data.frame(site_scores) %>%
  mutate(
    date = rda_data$date,
    cluster = rda_data$abs_clust,
    year = year(date),
    month = month(date),
    season = case_when(
      month %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ "Winter",
      month %in% 3:5 ~ "Spring",
      month %in% 6:8 ~ "Summer",
      month %in% 9:11 ~ "Fall"
    )
  )

species_arrows <- as.data.frame(species_scores) %>%
  mutate(taxon = rownames(species_scores))

env_arrows <- as.data.frame(env_scores) %>%
  mutate(variable = rownames(env_scores))

# Calculate variance explained by each axis
variance_explained <- summary(rda_reduced)$cont$importance[2, 1:2] * 100

# Create biplot
p_rda <- ggplot() +
  # Sample points colored by cluster
  geom_point(data = plot_data, 
             aes(x = RDA1, y = RDA2, fill = factor(cluster)),
             size = 4, alpha = 0.7, shape = 21, color = "black") +
  
  # Phytoplankton group vectors (species scores)
  geom_segment(data = species_arrows,
               aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = RDA1 * 2, yend = RDA2 * 2),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.3, "cm")),
               color = "darkred", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_text(data = species_arrows,
            aes(x = RDA1 * 2.2, y = RDA2 * 2.2, label = taxon),
            color = "darkred", size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
  
  # Environmental vectors
  geom_segment(data = env_arrows,
               aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = RDA1 * 3, yend = RDA2 * 3),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.3, "cm")),
               color = "darkblue", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_text(data = env_arrows,
            aes(x = RDA1 * 3.3, y = RDA2 * 3.3, label = variable),
            color = "darkblue", size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
  
  # Formatting
  # scale_fill_manual(
  #   values = cluster_colors,
  #   labels = cluster_labels,
  #   name = "Community\nCluster"
  # ) +
  labs(
    title = "RDA: Environmental Drivers of Phytoplankton Community Composition",
    subtitle = paste0("Model R² = ", round(r2_reduced$adj.r.squared, 3),
                     " (p = ", format.pval(anova_full$`Pr(>F)`[1], digits = 3), ")"),
    x = paste0("RDA1 (", round(variance_explained[1], 1), "%)"),
    y = paste0("RDA2 (", round(variance_explained[2], 1), "%)"),
    caption = "Blue arrows = environmental drivers; Red arrows = phytoplankton groups"
  ) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1)
  )

print(p_rda)
ggsave(here("figures", "rda_environmental_drivers.png"),
       width = 12, height = 9, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. CLUSTER-ENVIRONMENT CORRELATIONS
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Calculate mean environmental conditions for each cluster
cluster_env_means <- rda_data %>%
  group_by(abs_clust) %>%
  summarise(
    across(all_of(colnames(env_predictors)), ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    n = n(),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

print(cluster_env_means)

# Save results
write_csv(cluster_env_means, here("outputs", "cluster_environmental_means.csv"))

# Correlation heatmap
cor_cluster_env <- cor(
  phyto_response,
  env_predictors,
  use = "pairwise.complete.obs"
)

library(pheatmap)
pheatmap(
  t(cor_cluster_env),
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("#2E8B57", "white", "#8B4513"))(100),
  main = "Phytoplankton-Environment Correlations",
  fontsize = 10,
  filename = here("figures", "correlation_heatmap.png"),
  width = 10,
  height = 8
)

cat("\n=== RDA ANALYSIS COMPLETE ===\n")
```

```{r}
#==============================================================================
# COMPLETE COMPARISON: Regular RDA vs Hellinger+RDA vs db-RDA
#==============================================================================

library(vegan)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(patchwork)

# Alternative option 2: Paul Tol's colorblind-safe palette
cluster_colors <- c(
  "1" = "#DDAA33",  # Gold - Mixed
  "2" = "#228833",  # Green - Diatoms
  "3" = "#CC6677",  # Rose/pink - Dinoflagellates
  "4" = "#4477AA"   # Blue - Winter
)

# Cluster labels with descriptions
cluster_labels <- c(
  "1" = "1 (Mixed)",
  "2" = "2 (Diatoms)",
  "3" = "3 (Dinoflagellates)",
  "4" = "4 (Winter)"
)

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Approach 1: Regular RDA (your original)
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("\n=== APPROACH 1: REGULAR RDA ===\n")

# Full model
rda_full <- rda(phyto_response ~ ., data = as.data.frame(env_scaled))

# Forward selection
rda_null <- rda(phyto_response ~ 1, data = as.data.frame(env_scaled))

rda_forward <- ordiR2step(
  rda_null,
  scope = formula(rda_full),
  direction = "forward",
  permutations = 999,
  trace = FALSE
)

rda_final <- rda_forward  # This is your final model

cat("Selected variables:", paste(attr(terms(rda_final), "term.labels"), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("R² =", round(RsquareAdj(rda_final)$adj.r.squared, 3), "\n")

print(anova(rda_final, permutations = 999))
print(anova(rda_final, by = "axis", permutations = 999))

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Approach 2: Hellinger Transformation + RDA
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("\n=== APPROACH 2: HELLINGER + RDA ===\n")

# Hellinger transform
phyto_hellinger <- decostand(phyto_response, method = "hellinger")

# Full model
rda_hellinger_full <- rda(phyto_hellinger ~ ., data = as.data.frame(env_scaled))

# Forward selection
rda_hellinger_null <- rda(phyto_hellinger ~ 1, data = as.data.frame(env_scaled))

rda_hellinger_forward <- ordiR2step(
  rda_hellinger_null,
  scope = formula(rda_hellinger_full),
  direction = "forward",
  permutations = 999,
  trace = FALSE
)

rda_hellinger_final <- rda_hellinger_forward

cat("Selected variables:", paste(attr(terms(rda_hellinger_final), "term.labels"), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("R² =", round(RsquareAdj(rda_hellinger_final)$adj.r.squared, 3), "\n")

print(anova(rda_hellinger_final, permutations = 999))
print(anova(rda_hellinger_final, by = "axis", permutations = 999))

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Approach 3: Distance-Based RDA (Bray-Curtis)
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("\n=== APPROACH 3: db-RDA (BRAY-CURTIS) ===\n")

# Calculate Bray-Curtis distance
phyto_dist_bray <- vegdist(phyto_response, method = "bray")

# Full model
dbrda_full <- capscale(phyto_dist_bray ~ ., data = as.data.frame(env_scaled))

# Forward selection
dbrda_null <- capscale(phyto_dist_bray ~ 1, data = as.data.frame(env_scaled))

dbrda_forward <- ordiR2step(
  dbrda_null,
  scope = formula(dbrda_full),
  direction = "forward",
  permutations = 999,
  trace = FALSE
)

dbrda_final <- dbrda_forward

cat("Selected variables:", paste(attr(terms(dbrda_final), "term.labels"), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("R² =", round(RsquareAdj(dbrda_final)$adj.r.squared, 3), "\n")

print(anova(dbrda_final, permutations = 999))
print(anova(dbrda_final, by = "axis", permutations = 999))

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create Comparison Table
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("\n=== COMPARISON SUMMARY ===\n")

comparison_table <- data.frame(
  Method = c("Regular RDA", 
             "Hellinger + RDA", 
             "db-RDA (Bray-Curtis)"),
  
  R2_adjusted = c(
    round(RsquareAdj(rda_final)$adj.r.squared, 3),
    round(RsquareAdj(rda_hellinger_final)$adj.r.squared, 3),
    round(RsquareAdj(dbrda_final)$adj.r.squared, 3)
  ),
  
  n_variables = c(
    length(attr(terms(rda_final), "term.labels")),
    length(attr(terms(rda_hellinger_final), "term.labels")),
    length(attr(terms(dbrda_final), "term.labels"))
  ),
  
  Variables = c(
    paste(attr(terms(rda_final), "term.labels"), collapse = ", "),
    paste(attr(terms(rda_hellinger_final), "term.labels"), collapse = ", "),
    paste(attr(terms(dbrda_final), "term.labels"), collapse = ", ")
  )
)

print(comparison_table)
write_csv(comparison_table, here("outputs", "rda_method_comparison.csv"))

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Plot All Three Side-by-Side
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
```


```{r}
# Function to create consistent plots with EQUAL SIZES
create_ordination_plot <- function(model, title_text, method_type = "rda") {
  
  site_scores <- scores(model, display = "sites", choices = 1:2)
  env_scores <- scores(model, display = "bp", choices = 1:2)
  
  plot_data <- as.data.frame(site_scores) %>%
    mutate(cluster = factor(rda_data$abs_clust))
  
  # Get axis names (RDA vs CAP/dbRDA)
  axis_names <- colnames(site_scores)
  
  env_arrows <- as.data.frame(env_scores) %>%
    mutate(variable = rownames(env_scores))
  
  # Variance explained
  var_exp <- summary(model)$cont$importance[2, 1:2] * 100
  
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_point(data = plot_data,
               aes(x = .data[[axis_names[1]]], 
                   y = .data[[axis_names[2]]], 
                   fill = cluster),
               size = 3, alpha = 0.7, shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = 0.3) +
    geom_segment(data = env_arrows,
                 aes(x = 0, y = 0, 
                     xend = .data[[axis_names[1]]] * 3, 
                     yend = .data[[axis_names[2]]] * 3),
                 arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")),
                 color = "darkblue", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_text(data = env_arrows,
              aes(x = .data[[axis_names[1]]] * 3.3, 
                  y = .data[[axis_names[2]]] * 3.3, 
                  label = variable),
              color = "darkblue", size = 3, fontface = "bold") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_colors, labels = cluster_labels,
                     name = "Cluster") +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      subtitle = paste0("R² = ", round(RsquareAdj(model)$adj.r.squared, 3)),
      x = paste0(axis_names[1], " (", round(var_exp[1], 1), "%)"),
      y = paste0(axis_names[2], " (", round(var_exp[2], 1), "%)")
    ) +
    # REMOVED coord_fixed() - this was causing different sizes
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      aspect.ratio = 1,  # ADDED - forces square plots with equal sizes
      plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2)  # Small consistent margins
    )
  
  return(p)
}

# Create individual plots
p1 <- create_ordination_plot(rda_final, "Regular RDA")
p2 <- create_ordination_plot(rda_hellinger_final, "Hellinger + RDA")
p3 <- create_ordination_plot(dbrda_final, "db-RDA (Bray-Curtis)")

# Combine with equal widths
p_comparison <- (p1 | p2 | p3) + 
  plot_layout(
    guides = "collect",
    widths = c(1, 1, 1)  # Force equal panel widths
  ) &
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
  )

print(p_comparison)

ggsave(here("figures", "rda_methods_comparison.png"),
       width = 15, height = 5.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

```{r}
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Publication-Quality db-RDA Plot - Fixed text cutoff
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Extract scores
site_scores <- scores(dbrda_final, display = "sites", choices = 1:2)
env_scores <- scores(dbrda_final, display = "bp", choices = 1:2)

# Prepare data
plot_data <- as.data.frame(site_scores) %>%
  mutate(cluster = factor(rda_data$abs_clust))

env_arrows <- as.data.frame(env_scores) %>%
  mutate(
    variable = rownames(env_scores),
    label = recode(variable,
                  "nitrate_5" = "Nitrate (5m)",
                  "nitrate_5m" = "Nitrate (5m)",
                  "NP_ratio_5m" = "N:P Ratio",
                  "np_5m" = "N:P Ratio",
                  "temp_5m" = "Temperature",
                  "int_chla" = "Integrated Chl-a",
                  "scm_depth" = "SCM Depth",
                  "rd_b1" = "Density Gradient",
                  "rd_b1_3" = "Density Gradient",
                  .default = variable)
  )

# Variance explained
var_exp <- summary(dbrda_final)$cont$importance[2, 1:2] * 100

# Create plot
p_dbrda_final <- ggplot() +
  
  # Points
  geom_point(data = plot_data,
             aes(x = CAP1, y = CAP2, fill = cluster, shape = cluster),
             size = 8,
             alpha = 0.9,
             color = "black", 
             stroke = 1) +
  
  # Environmental arrows - slightly shorter to make room for labels
  geom_segment(data = env_arrows,
               aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = CAP1 * 2.5, yend = CAP2 * 2.5),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.5, "cm"), type = "closed"),
               color = "#2C5F8D", 
               linewidth = 2) +
  
  # Environmental labels - shorter extension
  geom_text(data = env_arrows,
            aes(x = CAP1 * 2.9, y = CAP2 * 2.9, label = label),
            color = "#2C5F8D",

            fontface = "bold") +
  
  # Shapes
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c("1" = 21, "2" = 22, "3" = 23, "4" = 24),
    labels = cluster_labels,
    name = "Community Cluster"
  ) +
  
  # Colors
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = cluster_colors, 
    labels = cluster_labels,
    name = "Community Cluster"
  ) +
  
  # Expand plot limits to include labels
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.15)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.15)) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Environmental Drivers of Phytoplankton Community Composition",
    x = paste0("CAP1 (", round(var_exp[1], 1), "%)"),
    y = paste0("CAP2 (", round(var_exp[2], 1), "%)"),
    caption = paste0("Distance-based RDA (Bray-Curtis) | R² = ", 
                    round(RsquareAdj(dbrda_final)$adj.r.squared, 3),
                    " | p < 0.001")
  ) +
  
  # Theme
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    # Title
    plot.title = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, 
                             margin = margin(b = 15)),
    
    # Axis titles
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 15)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", margin = margin(r = 15)),
    
    # Axis text
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
    
    # Legend
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.key.size = unit(1.5, "cm"),
    
    # Caption
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 1, color = "gray30",
                               margin = margin(t = 10)),
    
    # Panel
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1.2),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray85", linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    
    # Margins - BIGGER to prevent cutoff
    plot.margin = margin(30, 30, 30, 30),
    
    # CRITICAL - allow drawing outside panel
    plot.clip = "off"
  ) +
  
  # Allow drawing outside plot area
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off")

print(p_dbrda_final)

# Save

)

    anova(rda_hellinger_final, by = "axis", permutations = 999)$`Pr(>F)`[1],

  ),
  
  RDA2_p = c(

    anova(rda_hellinger_final, by = "axis", permutations = 999)$`Pr(>F)`[2],

  )
)

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Mantel tests to compare distance matrices
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("\n=== DISTANCE MATRIX CORRELATIONS ===\n")

# Original RDA uses Euclidean distance
dist_euclidean <- dist(phyto_response, method = "euclidean")

# Hellinger uses Euclidean on transformed data
dist_hellinger_eucl <- dist(phyto_hellinger, method = "euclidean")

# db-RDA uses Bray-Curtis
# (already calculated as phyto_dist_bray)

# Compare distance matrices
mantel_euc_bray <- mantel(dist_euclidean, phyto_dist_bray, permutations = 999)
cat("\nEuclidean vs Bray-Curtis:\n")
print(mantel_euc_bray)

mantel_hell_bray <- mantel(dist_hellinger_eucl, phyto_dist_bray, permutations = 999)
cat("\nHellinger-Euclidean vs Bray-Curtis:\n")
print(mantel_hell_bray)

mantel_euc_hell <- mantel(dist_euclidean, dist_hellinger_eucl, permutations = 999)
cat("\nEuclidean vs Hellinger-Euclidean:\n")
print(mantel_euc_hell)

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Which variables were selected by each method?
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("\n=== SELECTED VARIABLES BY METHOD ===\n")

vars_regular <- attr(terms(rda_final), "term.labels")
vars_hellinger <- attr(terms(rda_hellinger_final), "term.labels")
vars_dbrda <- attr(terms(dbrda_final), "term.labels")

cat("\nRegular RDA:", paste(vars_regular, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Hellinger + RDA:", paste(vars_hellinger, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("db-RDA:", paste(vars_dbrda, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Which variables are common to all?
common_vars <- Reduce(intersect, list(vars_regular, vars_hellinger, vars_dbrda))
cat("\nCommon to all methods:", paste(common_vars, collapse = ", "), "\n")

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Check if axis 2 is significant in any method
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("\n=== AXIS 2 SIGNIFICANCE ===\n")

axis_tests <- data.frame(
  Method = c("Regular RDA", "Hellinger + RDA", "db-RDA"),
  
  Axis1_pval = c(
    anova(rda_final, by = "axis", permutations = 999)$`Pr(>F)`[1],
    anova(rda_hellinger_final, by = "axis", permutations = 999)$`Pr(>F)`[1],
    anova(dbrda_final, by = "axis", permutations = 999)$`Pr(>F)`[1]
  ),
  
  Axis2_pval = c(
    anova(rda_final, by = "axis", permutations = 999)$`Pr(>F)`[2],
    anova(rda_hellinger_final, by = "axis", permutations = 999)$`Pr(>F)`[2],
    anova(dbrda_final, by = "axis", permutations = 999)$`Pr(>F)`[2]
  ),
  
  Axis1_var = c(
    summary(rda_final)$cont$importance[2, 1] * 100,
    summary(rda_hellinger_final)$cont$importance[2, 1] * 100,
    summary(dbrda_final)$cont$importance[2, 1] * 100
  ),
  
  Axis2_var = c(
    summary(rda_final)$cont$importance[2, 2] * 100,
    summary(rda_hellinger_final)$cont$importance[2, 2] * 100,
    summary(dbrda_final)$cont$importance[2, 2] * 100
  )
)

print(axis_tests)
write_csv(axis_tests, here("outputs", "axis_significance_all_methods.csv"))

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Variable importance across methods
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("\n=== VARIABLE SIGNIFICANCE IN EACH MODEL ===\n")

# Regular RDA
cat("\nRegular RDA term significance:\n")
print(anova(rda_final, by = "terms", permutations = 999))

# Hellinger RDA
cat("\nHellinger + RDA term significance:\n")
print(anova(rda_hellinger_final, by = "terms", permutations = 999))

# db-RDA
cat("\ndb-RDA term significance:\n")
print(anova(dbrda_final, by = "terms", permutations = 999))

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. How well do clusters separate on Axis 1 in each method?
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Extract axis 1 scores for each method
rda1_scores <- data.frame(
  cluster = factor(rda_data$abs_clust),
  Regular_RDA1 = scores(rda_final, display = "sites", choices = 1)[, 1],
  Hellinger_RDA1 = scores(rda_hellinger_final, display = "sites", choices = 1)[, 1],
  dbRDA_CAP1 = scores(dbrda_final, display = "sites", choices = 1)[, 1]
)

# ANOVA: Does cluster explain variance on axis 1?
cat("\n=== CLUSTER SEPARATION ON AXIS 1 ===\n")

aov_regular <- aov(Regular_RDA1 ~ cluster, data = rda1_scores)
cat("\nRegular RDA1 ~ Cluster:\n")
print(summary(aov_regular))

aov_hellinger <- aov(Hellinger_RDA1 ~ cluster, data = rda1_scores)
cat("\nHellinger RDA1 ~ Cluster:\n")
print(summary(aov_hellinger))

aov_dbrda <- aov(dbRDA_CAP1 ~ cluster, data = rda1_scores)
cat("\ndb-RDA CAP1 ~ Cluster:\n")
print(summary(aov_dbrda))

# Plot axis 1 scores by cluster for each method
p_axis1_comparison <- rda1_scores %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -cluster, names_to = "Method", values_to = "Axis1_score") %>%
  mutate(Method = recode(Method,
                        "Regular_RDA1" = "Regular RDA",
                        "Hellinger_RDA1" = "Hellinger + RDA",
                        "dbRDA_CAP1" = "db-RDA")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = cluster, y = Axis1_score, fill = cluster)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.3, size = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~Method, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_colors, labels = cluster_labels) +
  labs(
    title = "Cluster Separation on Primary Axis",
    subtitle = "Which method best separates clusters?",
    x = "Cluster",
    y = "Axis 1 Score"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

print(p_axis1_comparison)
ggsave(here("figures", "axis1_cluster_separation_comparison.png"),
       width = 12, height = 4, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Procrustes analysis - Are ordinations similar?
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("\n=== PROCRUSTES COMPARISON ===\n")

# Compare configurations
proc_reg_hell <- procrustes(
  scores(rda_final, display = "sites", choices = 1:2),
  scores(rda_hellinger_final, display = "sites", choices = 1:2)
)

proc_reg_db <- procrustes(
  scores(rda_final, display = "sites", choices = 1:2),
  scores(dbrda_final, display = "sites", choices = 1:2)
)

proc_hell_db <- procrustes(
  scores(rda_hellinger_final, display = "sites", choices = 1:2),
  scores(dbrda_final, display = "sites", choices = 1:2)
)

cat("\nRegular vs Hellinger: m² =", round(proc_reg_hell$ss, 3), "\n")
cat("Regular vs db-RDA: m² =", round(proc_reg_db$ss, 3), "\n")
cat("Hellinger vs db-RDA: m² =", round(proc_hell_db$ss, 3), "\n")
cat("\n(Lower m² = more similar ordinations)\n")

# Protest (significance test)
cat("\n=== PROTEST (Procrustes + permutation test) ===\n")
protest_reg_hell <- protest(
  scores(rda_final, display = "sites", choices = 1:2),
  scores(rda_hellinger_final, display = "sites", choices = 1:2),
  permutations = 999
)
print(protest_reg_hell)

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Environmental gradients comparison
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Extract environmental loadings on axis 1
env_loadings_comparison <- data.frame(
  Variable = rownames(scores(rda_final, display = "bp", choices = 1)),
  Regular_RDA = scores(rda_final, display = "bp", choices = 1)[, 1],
  Hellinger_RDA = scores(rda_hellinger_final, display = "bp", choices = 1)[, 1],
  dbRDA = scores(dbrda_final, display = "bp", choices = 1)[, 1]
) %>%
  pivot_longer(-Variable, names_to = "Method", values_to = "Loading") %>%
  arrange(Method, desc(abs(Loading)))

cat("\n=== ENVIRONMENTAL LOADINGS ON AXIS 1 ===\n")
print(env_loadings_comparison)

species_scores <- scores(dbrda_final, display = "species", choices = 1:2)
env_scores <- scores(dbrda_final, display = "bp", choices = 1:2)

# Prepare data
plot_data <- as.data.frame(site_scores) %>%
  mutate(
    cluster = factor(rda_data$abs_cluster),
    date = rda_data$date,
    season = case_when(
      month(date) %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ "Winter",
      month(date) %in% 3:5 ~ "Spring",
      month(date) %in% 6:8 ~ "Summer",
      month(date) %in% 9:11 ~ "Fall"
    )
  )

species_arrows <- as.data.frame(species_scores) %>%
  mutate(taxon = rownames(species_scores))

env_arrows <- as.data.frame(env_scores) %>%
  mutate(
    variable = rownames(env_scores),
    label = recode(variable,
                  "nitrate_5m" = "NO₃ (5m)",
                  "NP_ratio_5m" = "N:P Ratio",
                  "np_5m" = "N:P (5m)",
                  .default = variable)
  )

# Variance for labels
var_exp <- summary(dbrda_final)$cont$importance[2, 1:2] * 100

# Final publication plot
p_dbrda_final <- ggplot() +
  # Points
  geom_point(data = plot_data, 
             aes(x = CAP1, y = CAP2, fill = cluster),
             size = 3.5, alpha = 0.75, shape = 21, 
             color = "black", stroke = 0.4) +
  
  # Species arrows
  geom_segment(data = species_arrows,
               aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = MDS1 * 2, yend = MDS2 * 2),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")),
               color = "#B8413C", linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text(data = species_arrows,
            aes(x = MDS1 * 2.2, y = MDS2 * 2.2, label = taxon),
            color = "#B8413C", size = 3.5, fontface = "italic") +
  
  # Environmental arrows
  geom_segment(data = env_arrows,
               aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = CAP1 * 3, yend = CAP2 * 3),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.35, "cm"), type = "closed"),
               color = "#2C5F8D", linewidth = 1.3) +
  geom_text(data = env_arrows,
            aes(x = CAP1 * 3.4, y = CAP2 * 3.4, label = label),
            color = "#2C5F8D", size = 4.5, fontface = "bold") +
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_colors, labels = cluster_labels,
                   name = "Community\nCluster") +
  labs(
    title = "Distance-Based RDA: Environmental Drivers of Phytoplankton Communities",
    subtitle = paste0("Bray-Curtis distance | Adjusted R² = ", 
                     round(RsquareAdj(dbrda_final)$adj.r.squared, 3)),
    x = paste0("CAP1 (", round(var_exp[1], 1), "%)"),
    y = paste0("CAP2 (", round(var_exp[2], 1), "%)"),
    caption = "Two significant axes | Blue = environmental drivers | Red = phytoplankton groups"
  ) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 1, color = "gray40"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.3)
  )

print(p_dbrda_final)
ggsave(here("figures", "dbrda_final_publication.png"),
       width = 11, height = 9, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```
